overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a collective following of 3,580. His posts consistently focus on computational social science, disinformation research, tool development, and career opportunities. Across all channels, his audience demonstrates remarkable engagement, with high relative interaction rates driven by interest in open-source tools, publication announcements, and academic recruiting.

contentThemes.description: Technological advancements, methodological frameworks, and research papers focused on analyzing link sharing and coordinated campaigns.
Sourcing postdoctoral researchers and PhD candidates for computational social science initiatives.
Announcements regarding major grant awards, upcoming conference talks, and software releases like CooRnet v2.0.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's highly active academic community by increasing posting frequency, as it currently yields the highest relative engagement rates.
Utilize LinkedIn primarily for recruiting and major institutional news to maximize absolute reach and direct professional applications.
Include direct links to tools (like CooRnet on GitHub) and paper DOIs to capture high intent from engaged users on Mastodon and Bluesky.

platformInsights.bluesky: Serves as the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14%, proving highly effective for sharing research papers and student opportunities with an active academic community.
platformInsights.mastodon: Attracts a highly dedicated technical audience (4.55% average engagement rate) that shows strong interest in open-source tool updates like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Yields the highest absolute reach and engagement volume, serving as the optimal platform for professional announcements such as hiring calls and multi-platform research grants.
